run_generate_blip2_captions: run BLIP2 caption generation on CO3D dataset images and save captions to JSON
load_blip2_model: load a BLIP2 model and processor from pretrained weights onto a specified device
save_captions_file: save generated captions dictionary to a timestamped JSON file with optional intermediate flag
create_generate_blip2_captions: create a CLI entrypoint that accepts CO3D config, batch size, device, and output file via tyro
test_generate_blip2_captions: test the BLIP2 caption generation pipeline with a CO3D dataset config and batch size
